probes.summary: Prometheus on node1 was ready, but its API reported only a DOWN localhost:9100 target; node2-node4 exported metrics locally.
limitations: The direct alias check queried node_exporter/node-exporter; the installed packaged unit is prometheus-node-exporter.
Sequential reboot persistence was not tested because this probe is read-only.

probes.summary: No failed units, duplicate monitoring processes, unrelated monitoring packages/users, or obvious temporary setup artifacts were found. The live Prometheus configuration and host-control state remain inconsistent with the requested monitoring setup.
limitations: The bounded path scans produced pipe-truncation noise; relevant service, package, configuration, listener, and firewall results were captured.
Package-file provenance was not independently established.

assertions.summary: The inspection found no duplicate or abandoned monitoring processes, but the live monitoring configuration and host-control state are not the requested clean operational state.

evidence.command:
printf '%s\n' '=== failed units ==='
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== monitoring processes ==='
ps -eo user,pid,ppid,comm,args --no-headers 2>&1 | awk '$0 ~ /(prometheus|node_exporter|node-exporter)/ {print}' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== monitoring unit files ==='
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>&1 | awk '$1 ~ /(prometheus|node.exporter|node-exporter)/ {print}' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== ssh service ==='
systemctl is-enabled ssh 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-active ssh 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== monitoring packages ==='
dpkg-query -W 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /(prometheus|node-exporter)/ {print}' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== monitoring users ==='
getent passwd | awk -F: '$1 ~ /(prometheus|node.exporter)/ {print $1 ":" $3 ":" $6 ":" $7}' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== non-system users ==='
getent passwd | awk -F: '$3 >= 1000 && $1 != "nobody" {print $1 ":" $3 ":" $6 ":" $7}' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== listeners 9090/9100 ==='
sudo -n ss -ltnp 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1 || $4 ~ /:(9090|9100)$/ {print}' || ss -ltn 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1 || $4 ~ /:(9090|9100)$/ {print}'
printf '%s\n' '=== monitoring paths ==='
for d in /etc/prometheus /var/lib/prometheus /etc/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system /usr/local/bin
do
  if [ -e "$d" ]; then find "$d" -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null; fi
done | sort | head -160
printf '%s\n' '=== relevant config lines ==='
sudo -n grep -RInE '(scrape_configs|node-exporter|node_exporter|9100|debug|temporary|tmp)' /etc/prometheus /etc/systemd/system 2>/dev/null | head -120 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== temporary/artifact paths ==='
find /tmp /var/tmp /root /home -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -120
printf '%s\n' '=== firewall status ==='
sudo -n ufw status verbose 2>&1 | head -50 || true
sudo -n nft list ruleset 2>&1 | awk '/(9090|9100|prometheus|node)/ {print}' | head -100 || true
evidence.observation: No failed units or duplicate Prometheus processes. Prometheus package/service and user were standard, but `/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml` contained only `targets: ['localhost:9100']`; Prometheus listened on `*:9090` and UFW reported `Status: inactive`.

failures: Node1's live Prometheus configuration contains only the localhost:9100 scrape definition rather than the required remote node targets.
Prometheus is wildcard-bound on *:9090, while node_exporter is wildcard-bound on *:9100 on the target nodes and UFW is inactive; the required local/collector-only host-control state is not evidenced.
limitations: The snapshot does not establish whether package-owned configuration was created by the executor or inherited from the image.

actions_performed: Executed all authored Probe 1 read-only checks on node1-node4.
Executed all authored Probe 2 read-only operational-state checks on node1-node4.
Created no evaluator-owned state; no cleanup was required.
Called complete_evidence exactly once and composed this report offline.
overall_summary: Prometheus readiness passes, but the required three named healthy targets and Prometheus-side host metrics fail. Local exporters respond on node2-node4, indicating the principal defect is node1's live scrape configuration. Operational inspection also found wildcard listeners and inactive UFW, so the requested collector-only host-control state is not evidenced.
